skill.name: migrate-to-rust

description.zh: 克隆、分析并规划遗留代码库（C++、Fortran、Java、Python、C、Shell）向 100% Safe Rust 的现代化迁移：SoA/SIMD 架构设计、全流程遥测跟踪、测试失败修复闭环、LLVM PGO 性能调优，并产出第一人称工程叙事报告与交互式 HTML 信息图。
description.en: Clones, analyzes, plans, and migrates legacy codebases (C++, Fortran, Java, Python, C, Shell) to a modern, high-performance, deterministic, 100% Safe Rust architecture, tracking live telemetry, test failure/fix cycles, and PGO stages, and producing an AI storytelling report and interactive HTML infographic.

skill.usageExample: 把这个 C++ 仓库迁移成 100% Safe Rust，用 SoA 架构，做 PGO 调优，最后给我一份迁移报告和 HTML 信息图。
